usedFor: DitCal holds your bookings, and Zendesk Support gets a ticket when “Booking Cancelled” runs “Create Support Ticket”.

bestTemplate.name: “Booking Cancelled” in DitCal, then “Create Support Ticket” in Zendesk Support
bestTemplate.why: A cancellation opens a ticket, so someone in support can offer a new time.

watchOut: “Meeting Rescheduled” in DitCal fires on every change, so it can open several tickets for one meeting.
